title: yamaa 1.0 project file
description: One file of the 1.0 project type. A project file that names a parent or clears what it inherits is one layer of a chain: the header is required in every layer, a root field it writes is complete there, and inside environments, study or a section requiredness waits for the composed project, which $defs/project_class checks (PROJECT-16). Each field carries its kind as x-yamaa-kind and its schema-notation type as x-yamaa-type. Generated from yaml/ by tools/packaging/generate_json_schema.py.
